record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, jointly set MAXLEN=64 and batch size=256, retaining width 64, two blocks, two heads, learning rate 7e-4 and dropout 0.1. Shorter sequences reduce padded attention work because history p95 is at most 39; larger batches provide more masked targets per update and may reduce gradient noise. Preserve feature definitions, embedding tying, interaction/readout formulas, loss and optimizer. Keep seed 42, 200 batches per epoch and the 200-epoch cap; propagate dimensions through checkpoint metadata and prediction.

category_rationales.rationale: Jointly shorten MAXLEN to 64 and increase batch size to 256 across all four categories. Shorter sequences reduce attention cost, while larger batches supply more masked targets per update. Retain learning rate 7e-4 and dropout 0.1. Existing checkpoint metadata and predictor construction propagate MAXLEN consistently. Preserve the BERT4Rec backbone, features, embedding tying, readout, loss, optimizer, seeds and training limits.
